CREATE TABLE tock_field_history (
  source_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  field TEXT NOT NULL,
  day TEXT NOT NULL,
  first_seen TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_seen TEXT NOT NULL,
  n INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (source_key, field, day)
);

CREATE TABLE tock_labels (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  dim TEXT NOT NULL,
  value TEXT NOT NULL,
  label TEXT NOT NULL,
  captured_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (run_id, dim, value)
);

CREATE TABLE tock_observations (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tock_runs(id),
  field TEXT NOT NULL,
  present_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  null_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  inferred_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  distinct_estimate INTEGER NOT NULL,
  declared INTEGER NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (run_id, field)
);

CREATE TABLE tock_rollups (
  source_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  grain TEXT NOT NULL,
  dim_set TEXT NOT NULL,
  period_start TEXT NOT NULL,
  dim1 TEXT NOT NULL,
  dim2 TEXT NOT NULL,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  events INTEGER NOT NULL,
  measure TEXT,
  unit TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (source_key, grain, dim_set, period_start, dim1, dim2, run_id)
);

CREATE TABLE tock_rows (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tock_runs(id),
  occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  subject_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  dims_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  metrics_json TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE tock_rule_states (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tock_runs(id),
  rule_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (rule_kind IN ('bot_list','threshold','dedup_window','salt')),
  identifier TEXT NOT NULL,
  content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  captured_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (run_id, rule_kind)
);

CREATE TABLE tock_runs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  source_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  schema_version INTEGER,
  filename TEXT NOT NULL,
  byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL,
  content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('received','profiled','mapped','counted','failed')),
  period_from TEXT NOT NULL,
  period_to TEXT NOT NULL,
  row_count INTEGER,
  rejected_count INTEGER,
  received_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  received_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  counted_at TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE tock_salts (
  day TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  salt_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  secret TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  destroyed_at TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE tock_schemas (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  source_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  fields_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (source_key, version)
);

CREATE TABLE tock_source_files (
  run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES tock_runs(id),
  content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL,
  storage_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  stored_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  purge_after TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE tock_sources (
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  expected_cadence TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
